cultural.vision_reason: Leather trousers/apron-style garment heavily decorated with beadwork, metal discs, and long fringing — a type of traditional dress consistent with Siberian Evenki/Tungusic women's clothing. No contrary evidence in the record.

physical.title: trousers; underpants
physical.summary: A pair of woman's trousers, or underpants, made of leather, and decorated with beads and metal discs.  Upper front panel decorated with black, white and turquoise glass (?) beads stitched onto strips of brown and green tabby cotton (?) cloth.  An additional bead encrusted rectangular leather panel stitched to lower third of trousers, with an oval flap at each side.  Almost completely covered in strings of couched beads; a row of silver-coloured round metal discs at hemline.  Larger strung blue and green beads suspended from bottom edge.  Long leather fringing at hemline of main trousers.  Leather drawstring.
